_note: What we are making and how far along it is. Rendered to /kit/builds by kit/build-kit.py. Edit this file, never the generated page. Mirrors temper/notes/builds.json. Sean or any chat may edit — it is shared. `stage` is one of: planned | building | shipped | parked. Keep `what` to one line; put the reasoning in `note`.

builds.title: The 21 section fragments
builds.what: Every page composed from stacked section shortcodes rather than one monolith per page.
builds.note: 18 original + 3 for Contact. The five legacy whole-page fragments were retired on 2026-08-13 — they had drifted from the sections they duplicated while STATUS described them as working.

builds.title: Editable sections (ACF)
builds.what: 19 sections editable in wp-admin — 88 fields, no import step, a field change goes live on push.
builds.note: Declare a slot in sections/<id>/slots.json, run kit/build-acf.py, push. brg-acf.php fetches the generated groups from Netlify and registers them. Four sections stay as code pending repeaters.

builds.title: Repeater support
builds.what: Repeating rows so the crew grid, core values, LinkedIn posts and brand plates become editable.
builds.note: The last gap in 'anything editable at any point'. Flat slots would bake in a count we know changes — core values already went 6 to 5. Needs a repeater slot type, a repeating fill in the plugin, and a row-template convention.

builds.title: Self-deploying WordPress plugin
builds.what: A push touching website/wp-mu-plugin/ deploys the PHP and verifies the version that landed on the server.
builds.note: scp succeeding only proves bytes moved, so the run SSHes back in and greps VCC_VERSION out of the deployed file. Retired the manual plugin drop entirely.

builds.title: Contact page
builds.what: Three sections, 19 slots, built and deployed — waiting on the WP page and a form destination.
builds.note: No map embed: a third-party map inlined into WordPress means cookies, a consent banner and a second JS engine.

builds.title: Press & Gallery page
builds.what: The last page from the original seven-artboard IA that has never been built.
builds.note: Spec exists. Needs artwork decisions and a violet accent token that does not exist yet.

builds.title: Hero underline rework
builds.what: Size the marker to the words it sits under instead of a fixed 340px.
builds.note: Approved. Today the careers marker is several times wider than the word it underlines. Two MIT reference implementations supplied; the underlined text must never wrap.

builds.title: Launch
builds.what: Point the root at the home page, unlock the password gate, retire the Oxygen splash.
builds.note: Parked rather than blocked: the remaining work is content only — team headshots, real photography, LinkedIn job URLs.
